text:
The plate is a square-ish side plate, about 20 cm across. It holds roughly 10-12 chunks of honeydew melon, each about 3 cm. At roughly 8-10 g per cm³ of volume... more simply, each chunk is about 3×2.5×1.5 cm ≈ 11 cm³, or about 11 g, so 11 chunks come to about 120-130 g. Some chunks are larger, so I'll estimate 130 g.

Honeydew has about 36 kcal per 100 g, so 130 g is about 47 kcal.

```json
{"kcal": 47, "mass_g": 130}
```
